issuer: the Direction des Transports Routiers et Ferroviaires (DTRF)
note: Read 2026-10-31 in archive.org's snapshot of 27 May 2023 of the DTRF's own leaflet 'L'examen des permis de conduire' (dtrf.tg/backend/fichiers). It says the only condition for a licence is passing the DTRF's examination, at the DTRF in Lomé or its regional subdivisions; that for categories A, B and F the candidate must be 18 on the day of registration (C, D and E: 21); and that the examination's receipt costs 25,000 F CFA for B and F. The fee is null: the 25,000 F CFA is the examination's, not the licence's issue (with a 500 F CFA stamp); the term isn't stated (the EU's PRADO entry giving at most 5 years wasn't read: consilium.europa.eu answers a browser check). No later DTRF text than this 2023 leaflet was found.
